title: Improper scaling for title bar search for settings Search bar

judgment.rationale: Investigate the shared titlebar content-measure/occlusion boundary, while keeping this report's trigger distinct from the related search-layout report. The existing Narrow minimum override and caption insets are counterevidence to a simplistic missing-minimum or missing-inset claim. Do not request generic logs for a visible layout defect.
evidence: The supplied sequence shrinks Settings until navigation collapses; search/admin title content overlaps the minimize/maximize region.
The report's visual trigger is already specific enough for a maintainer reproduction.
Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/ShellPage.xaml: Search is TitleBar content and overrides TitleBarContentMinWidth to 516.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Controls/TitleBar/TitleBar.xaml: Wide mode uses an Auto content column, but Narrow already changes it to star width and sets the content minimum to zero. A permanent 516-DIP constraint is therefore not an established root cause.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Controls/TitleBar/TitleBar.WASDK.cs: The template reserves left/right caption-button inset columns. Actual clipping, breakpoint and inset units must be measured before claiming the reservation is absent.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. Current source exposes the relevant sizing boundary but already includes narrow-state and inset protections; the failing measure/state is unverified.

proposed_fixes.title: Constrain Settings search to the measured titlebar content region
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: content desired size or a wide/narrow transition can exceed the remaining non-caption region under the reported trigger. The exact state/measure failure has not been reproduced.
plan: Reproduce the exact report trigger and record titlebar visual state, query desired/actual width, title width, DPI and caption inset bounds.
Identify whether the failure is a stale breakpoint/state, content desired-width growth or incorrect reserved-region calculation.
Apply an available-width constraint or correct that transition at the identified boundary; preserve title/menu access, keyboard search and caption hit testing.
verification: The reported resize or long-query trigger never paints or hit-tests over caption buttons.
Empty/long queries, elevated/non-elevated titles, narrow/wide transitions and representative DPI/RTL layouts retain usable search and window controls.

confidence.rationale: Current source exposes the relevant sizing boundary but already includes narrow-state and inset protections; the failing measure/state is unverified.

reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable release; compare the reported version only in an isolated test environment if needed.
prerequisites: Use a disposable test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: Resize Settings through navigation-collapse and titlebar narrow/wide breakpoints with the elevated title visible.
Record the current titlebar visual state and search/title/caption rectangles at representative DPI values.
Verify both search input and minimize/maximize/close hit targets while entering and deleting the long query.
